findings.title: Canonical backend and fallback authority remain undecided
findings.details: The current issue version presents Postgres and config projection as alternatives but does not select the authoritative source, decide whether the other backend remains supported, or define exact fallback activation and write behavior. The expected state is an authenticated owner decision preventing split-brain, silent divergence, and unauthorized promotion. Action: obtain and record that decision before implementation.

findings.title: Single repository ownership and revision boundary are unspecified
findings.details: For marius-patrik/Andromeda#211, the owning child repository/gitlink, configured URL, admitted base revision, affected paths, feature-branch boundary, and responsibility for the umbrella gitlink update are absent. The expected submodule pointer contract must identify one accessible child lane and exact revision evidence before work can be assigned or verified.

findings.title: Scope and dependency boundaries are unresolved
findings.details: The issue lacks owner-approved non-goals and objective sequencing evidence. Verified supplied state shows #210 and #212 are open, while #211 neither defines the default-branch or release condition that completes #210 nor divides active-role and switcher-state ownership with #212. Naming, control-plane behavior, deployment topology, credential management, and unrelated configuration therefore remain exposed to overlap.

findings.title: Persistence, failure, and trust semantics are not executable
findings.details: The appended review section requests, but does not provide, the schema and identity rules, atomicity, concurrency control, ordering, durability, restart guarantees, disagreement handling, corruption and partial-migration behavior, or trust boundaries for credentials, configuration, stored data, logs, and errors. These semantics must be owner-approved and objectively testable before acceptance can be adjudicated.

findings.title: Migration and rollout policy require owner authorization
findings.details: No approved policy defines behavior for existing registry/*.yaml installations, mixed-version deployments, cutover, canonical-backend unavailability, or rollback. The expected contract must authorize an idempotent migration with preflight validation, recoverable backup, integrity checks, compatibility handling, cutover verification, losslessness evidence, and rollback.

findings.title: Required validation and delivery evidence are unspecified
findings.details: The issue does not select GATEWAY_PG_DSN, a container fixture, or both as the mandatory live gate; identify authoritative child and umbrella validation commands; assign fixture ownership; enumerate required failure cases; or define exact delivered-revision and main-branch or release evidence. The independent Validate gate's omitted execution results are not a finding, but the contract's validation coverage itself remains unverifiable.

findings.title: Workflow label does not reflect the owner-blocked state
findings.details: Verified target data for marius-patrik/Andromeda#211 shows only label P1. Trusted policy provides df:ask-owner and df:reviewed; because authenticated owner decisions remain unresolved, the expected routing label is df:ask-owner, while df:reviewed must remain absent until a clean iterative review and independent final confirmation succeed.
